The Router was not too lenient; in fact, the failure is catastrophic regarding class alignment.

Only 2 out of 7 testable checkpoints passed (generic body traits), resulting in a very low alignment score comparable to the 'hammerhead' reference (1.11) but slightly higher due to the subject actually being a butterfly.

The artifact score is high (good quality) because the generation is visually clean, even if semantically wrong.
